title: eternal_core_starter
description: Tired of the hassle of Mending? This mod introduces a new item that directly applies an "Unbreakable" tag to tools and armor, completely eliminating durability loss and making your gear truly eter
body:
Eternal Core: Starter is a practical utility mod for Minecraft designed to optimize the vanilla survival experience. This mod adds the item "Eternal Core," which can apply the "Unbreakable" NBT tag to tools or armor at the game's code level.

The mod works on both client and server. Please note that if the client has this mod installed, the server must also have it installed (and vice versa).

### Installation
Please note that this mod is currently only compatible with NeoForge 1.21.1. Make sure you have the latest version of the NeoForge loader installed to avoid any issues. Then, simply place the mod file into your mods folder—no other mods or additional configuration are required.

### How to Use
- To apply to armor: Place the armor in your off-hand slot and the Eternal Core item in your main hand.
- To apply to tools: Place the tool in your main hand and the Eternal Core item in your off-hand.

### Notes
Due to the unique nature of this mod, it can apply the NBT tag to almost all tools and armor from other mods that have durability.
